cohort: 10 newborns (5 elective cesarean section and 5 vaginally delivered)
finding: While both ECS and VD newborns had similar bacterial richness and diversity, ECS newborns showed an underrepresentation of Bacteroides and an enrichment of opportunistic pathogenic species from the second week.
mod_finding: ECS newborns showed an underrepresentation of Bacteroides and an enrichment of opportunistic pathogenic species from the second week.
